name: Wicked Dreams
source:
n this game you will play Tracy Mills, a young woman living together with her mother in a small town - Newtown. Things become complicated after she discovers that she has magical powers. In time she learns that the source of her magical power is the sexual desires of those around her, and that it can influence their dreams and desires.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/rycgames]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你将扮演特蕾西·米尔斯，一名与母亲共同生活在纽敦小镇的年轻女子。当她发现自己拥有魔法力量后，事情变得复杂起来。渐渐地，她得知，这股力量源于周围人的性欲，还能够影响他们的梦境与欲望。

[根据[url=https://www.patreon.com/rycgames]Patreon[/url]简介编辑]
